post.description:
Add or update a file in a contract. \
 \
The body of the request must be content-type 'multipart/form-data' and contain the file data. \
 \
To update the contract document: Only specify the 'parentFileId' parameter. The 'folderId' and 'conflictResolution' parameters should not be used for these updates

parameters.name: comments
parameters.description: Comments to be added to the file

parameters.name: parentFileId
parameters.description: Creates a new version for the specified parent file id

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The id of the folder to upload the file within

parameters.name: conflictResolution
parameters.description:
Defines behaviour for when a file conflict is found

Options:

  • Replace
  • KeepBoth
  • SaveVersion
  • Skip

201.description: The id of the created file

204.description: When the file was skipped due to conflict resolution setting

get.description:
Gets contracts filtered by single or multiple fields.
_To filter by one field_: "filtering.field", "filtering.operator" and "filtering.value" parameters must be filled.
_To filter by multiple fields_: "filtering.logic" and "filtering.filters" parameters must be filled.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: The number of contracts to skip (used for paging)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to include in the response

parameters.name: filtering.logic
parameters.description: Gets or sets the filtering logic for filters. Value by default is 'and'

parameters.name: filtering.filters
parameters.description:
Array of filters object (optional)
_Object Properties_:
* _Field_: field to filter by
* _Operator_: operator used to filter by
* _Value_: value to filter by

parameters.name: take
parameters.description:
The maximum number of contracts to return

Default: 50

parameters.name: context
parameters.description:
Controls the scope of contracts returned by this operation

Default: Personal

Options:

  • All - Returns all contracts regardless of whether the authenticated user is a member. Requires the authenticated user to be a member of the Contract Administrators security group
  • Personal - Returns contracts which the authenticated user is a member of. Equivalent to the "My contracts" view in LawVu
  • Teams - Returns all contracts that are accessible by teams that the authenticated user is a member of
  • Restricted - Returns restricted contracts. Requires the authenticated user to be an Organization Administrator
